answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 19220 Country: India Title: Are Men Permissible to wear Red Clothes Question: Are Men Permissible to wear Red Clothes Answer ID: 19220 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 127/120/D=1431) Cloth of full red colour not having strips of other colour is makrooh tanzihi for men, and it will be makrooh tahrimi if it resembles the clothing of women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
